segments.text: Good morning final year students. This is an important announcement regarding your B.Tex
CSEIML project evaluation. Please remember that the working prototype demonstrated on evaluation
day carries 40 percent of your total marks. The written project report carries 35 percent,
and the individual Viva Vocchi with each team member carries the remaining 25 percent.
Every member must attend the Viva in person. Do not miss the synopsis submission deadline on August
